short_blurb: From remodels to ground-up builds — your Temple City general contractor.
local_note: Whether you're modernizing a kitchen, adding a primary suite, converting a garage, or building an ADU, Palm Crest Builders brings licensed, code-compliant construction to Temple City. As a Class B general building contractor we coordinate every trade under one contract and keep your project on schedule and on budget. We build throughout Temple City, including Temple City, Arcadia adjacent, El Monte adjacent, and nearby neighborhoods.

faqs.q: Do you pull building permits in Temple City?
faqs.a: Yes — we handle plans, plan check, and permits through the Temple City building and safety department for every remodel, addition, and ADU, and we schedule all required inspections.

faqs.q: Can I build an ADU in Temple City?
faqs.a: In most cases, yes. Under California and Temple City rules, most single-family lots qualify for a detached, attached, or garage-conversion ADU. We handle feasibility, design, permits, and construction.

faqs.q: How long will my Temple City remodel or addition take?
faqs.a: It depends on scope — bathrooms typically run 3–5 weeks, kitchens 4–8 weeks, and room additions 2–4 months. We give you a firm schedule with milestones in your written estimate.
